issues_found.description: internal/loomcli/run.go's `run` verb still calls the old free-function `attachArgv(socket, session string) []string` to build its terminal-handover argv: `attachArgv(c.reed.Socket(), c.reed.SessionName())`. That function no longer exists — it was renamed/replaced by `Engine.AttachArgv(cols, rows int) []string` in internal/reedengine/attach.go, and internal/reedcli/attach.go was updated to call the new method, but internal/loomcli/run.go was not. The old free function's doc comment in reedengine ('attach.go owns the attach argv both internal/reedcli and internal/loomcli build their terminal handover from') confirms loomcli was always meant to be a caller of this same builder, so this is a missed caller, not an intentionally-separate code path.
issues_found.evidence: 1) mcp__quarry__workspace_symbol for query "attachArgv" across the whole checkout returns no package-level function definition anywhere (only the renamed reedengine.attach.go symbols bareAttachArgv/chainedAttachArgv/Engine.AttachArgv and their tests). 2) mcp__quarry__textDocument_definition resolving the `attachArgv` symbol from within internal/loomcli/run.go itself returns status "not_found", i.e. the LSP cannot resolve the identifier used at line 295. 3) Ran `go build ./internal/loomcli/...` directly against the checked-out worktree at /tmp/loomyard-review-03, which fails with: `internal/loomcli/run.go:295:46: undefined: attachArgv` — the package does not compile.
